**Issue #2853 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2853: Patch: fold the card tests that re-prove engine keywords and one-verb effects
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### Kind

Architecture

### Why

This is #1125's pattern 2, which #1140 left open (see the plan's Open questions on #1125). The card scripts carry about 8,350 `#[test]`s in 774 files across seven sets:

| Set | Files | Tests |
|---|---:|---:|
| Classic | 91 | 1,669 |
| Core | 111 | 1,561 |
| Classic+ | 116 | 1,506 |
| Stinkyscape | 230 | 1,409 |
| Meditative | 132 | 1,307 |
| Training Grounds | 61 | 599 |
| Meditative+ | 33 | 303 |

Many of them re-prove what the engine's rule tests already own:

- **Cards re-proving engine keywords.** A card whose script is empty or a single generic verb, but whose tests walk the keyword's whole rule matrix. Pointmaster (`core/c020_pointmaster.rs`), for example, re-proves §4.3 First Strike and §4.4 Divine Shield, which `crates/engine/tests/rules` owns. Keep **one** smoke test per face proving that the printed keyword reaches play, and drop the rest.
- **One-verb cards** ("deals 3", "draws 2") with several tests that vary only the target or the count. The verb's edge cases (an empty library, fatigue, overkill, the hand cap) belong to the engine's effect tests.

### What to change

- Read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`, `crates/cards/README.md` §5, BUILD.md's must-pass tables (M4-T4, M9 to M12) and REVIEW.md B3 first (CLAUDE.md rules 6 and 10).
- For each card file, delete or fold the tests above. Before dropping a test as redundant, name the engine test (`crates/engine/tests/rules*`, or the effect's own tests) that owns the rule it re-proves.
- **Keep:**
  - Every test of the card's own behaviour: its cry, death, start-of-turn and activate hooks, prompts, traps, pools and cost modifiers.
  - One test per BUILD must-pass clause per face, base and Radiant (rule 6). If you drop a clause's test outright, change BUILD.md's table in the same PR and say why.
  - Any test with an R-id token in its name, unless the ruling's `proven_in` keeps another proof (rule 3). Edit `proven_in` in the note if a file drops out, and never run `cargo jackioh spec index`.
- Do not touch `crates/engine/tests/`, `crates/cards/tests/`, the golden fixture, fuzz, `gate`, any card's non-test code, `catalog.json` or `patches/`. `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` must name no card.
- **Shape:** this is too large for one PR. The planner should split it by set (one PR per set, with Stinkyscape possibly split in two), so that each review stays readable and so that it does not conflict with the per-card work running in parallel.

### Acceptance

- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh catalog check` and `cargo jackioh golden check` are green on every PR.
- Every ruling in `spec/rulings/` keeps a proving test. Every must-pass clause keeps one test per face, or BUILD.md changes in the same PR with the reason.
- `.github/coverage-floor.txt` is not lowered, and the daily coverage run in `super.yml` stays at or above it.
- Each PR lists the count removed per pattern and per set, and gives the engine test that owns each dropped keyword or verb rule.

### Blocked by, part of

Blocked by #2852, which deletes the readbacks in the same card files. Follows #1125. Siblings: #2846 to #2852.

### Difficulty (a guess)

hard: hundreds of card files across seven sets, judgment about engine rule ownership, and changes to BUILD's must-pass tables and the rulings' `proven_in`.

### Priority

No priority

### Who does it

The night bot (bot:build)
```

# Draft plan, issue #2853 (planner's working notes)

## Findings so far
- Blocker #2852 merged as #2863 (74af1cfbb). #1140 (325bb5488) did pattern 1 for Core/Classic/C+/Med.
- Planner cannot open issues; the issue asks one PR per set. Shape decision: this branch = Core only
  (111 files, 1,561 tests; the issue's own example Pointmaster core/c020); the other sets in Open
  questions for a person to open as sub-issues (e.g. `/squishy split bot`) before this merges.
- crates/cards/README.md §5, BUILD M4-T4 (BUILD.md lines 392-503), REVIEW B3.3 read.
- spec check (crates/tools/src/spec.rs): rule 2 = each proven_in path holds a test with token r<n>;
  rule 3 = every r<n> fn/mod token and every R<n> cited has a note. => an r-token test in a card file
  NOT listed in that ruling's proven_in may go without spec edits. Decision: never drop an r-token
  test from a file that ruling's proven_in lists (then no spec/ edits at all).
- Core files in some proven_in: c098(13) c097 c060 c042 c021(4) t_ghoul c096 c092 c090 c078 c055 c050
  c041 c023 c022 c004(3) t_coin c100 c087 c085 c083 c082 c080 c077 c069 c039 c038 c033 c032 c031
  c029(2) and one each: c095 c093 c089 c086 c074 c070 c067 c065_1 c064 c063 c061 c056 c052 c051_1
  c049 c044 c036 c027 c024 c019 c018 c014 c001.
- build.rs code blocks / CODE_LINES stop at `#[cfg(test)]` => editing only below it changes no card.
- tools/tests/acceptance.rs has no per-card test count rule. REVIEW B3.2 wants `mod tests` in each file.
- catalog.rs does not assert keywords; tests/cross/card_text.rs (R366) ties printed keywords to text.
- coverage: super.yml llvm-cov engine+cards+ai, floor 90 (.github/coverage-floor.txt).

## Scope decisions
- In scope: Core card files whose script is empty / keyword-only, or one hook of plain verbs with no
  branch, prompt or memory (pattern A keyword re-proofs, pattern B one-verb variants). Multi-hook or
  stateful cards: untouched.
- Per face keep: one test per must-pass clause; one keyword smoke per face; params.is_none; every
  own-hook test that is not a target/count variant; r-token tests whose file is in proven_in.

## Survey in progress: 4 subagents over Core batches (alphabetical, 28 files each).
- Counts now: classic 91/1669, classic_plus 116/1502, core 111/1561, meditative 132/1307,
  meditative_plus 33/301, stinkyscape 230/1387, training_grounds 61/592.
- Must-pass tables: Core M4-T4 BUILD.md:394; Classic :764; Classic+ :859; Meditative :987; Med+ :1130;
  Stinkyscape :1176; TG :1425 (TG also: every param() number has a test that tunes it).
- Doc: one sentence in crates/cards/README.md §5 after the params.is_none sentence (line ~286).
- cargo-llvm-cov not installed locally: coverage can't be measured here (risk).
- Engine owners verified: combat_resolution.rs combat_resolution_m2_t4::{a_first_strike_attacker_
  survives_a_defender_it_kills_4_3, two_first_strikers_strike_simultaneously_in_step_1_and_both_die_4_3,
  a_defender_in_defense_position_strikes_back_at_full_attack_4_3}; damage.rs step_1_divine_shield_negates_a_10_hit...
